text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A lineup that could practically be called 
a rematch of last year's Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: <chrname> fought admirably among them.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Venus Park. I thank you from the bottom 
of my heart for participating."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
""The pleasure is mine. I'm glad I came. 
...I could really feel the love from 
everyone.""

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"Mei Satake. Just as you said, there are 
many Umamusume in Japan who truly love 
France."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
""...Yes. And these girls will surpass you 
and become champions of the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe.""

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "...My goodness!"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"La victoire est à moi. (Victory belongs 
to me.)"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The news of Venus Park participating in 
the Representative Exchange Race sent a 
wave of excitement sweeping across Japan.

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Venus Park recognized the strength 
of the Japanese runners, so that's why she 
entered the Representative Exchange Race, 
right!?

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
"I can't wait...! Do I sign up as a 
Project L'Arc supporter on this website?!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Ms. Satake! Have the runners from 
'Project L'Arc' been decided yet?!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Who will earn a spot on the team!? What 
about <chrname>!?"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Haha. It's only March. It is far too early 
to make a decision.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
We plan to consider that along with her 
future potential for growth. Deciding on 
Japan's representative will be—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—Same as last year, at the end of June. 
After the 4th match of the "Representative 
Exchange Series."

Enthusiasm for "Project L'Arc" grew with 
each passing day. In response... <chrname> and I 
decided on something.
choice_data_list:
This passion is their expectation to see a 
dream. If so—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
So this is where you were! Trainer-san, is 
<chrname>-san heading straight to the next 
'Representative Exchange Match' like this?
choice_data_list:
Before that, I'll bring even more dreams 
to everyone.

text_block_list.text:
Our target is the final domestic spring GⅠ 
race available before going abroad. More 
than anything, it is tied deeply to 
"dreams"—
choice_data_list: I will be entering the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.text:
Even on that stage crowded with beloved 
star Umamusume, I want to become an 
Umamusume who can make you truly proud to 
call me "my dream."
choice_data_list:
And there, I'll show that she's the number 
one star!

text_block_list.text:
Let's show her strength to the people who 
support our shared promise. At the 
Takarazuka Kinen—we'll carry everyone's 
dreams!
